name: Gnomaren
source:
Gnomaren is the artificial version of [url=https://vndb.org/c5278]Gnome[/url], created and mass produced by [url=https://vndb.org/c17591]Promestein[/url].

She empowers her wielder with immense strength that prevents the welder's enemy from escaping a bind, even with Gnome up, but also slows them down in the process; [url=https://vndb.org/c5277]Sylph[/url] and Fallen Angel Dance are useful in dodging those slow moves. Gnomaren also provides additional endurance, halving all damage received to her wielder.

[From [url=https://mgq.miraheze.org/wiki/Gnomaren]Mon-musu Quest Wiki[/url]]
